scope: Four GitHub discovery catalogs reviewed. Four original-publisher archives downloaded and inspected. License-verified Kenney car and building models are integrated into the live renderer; shared atlases are loaded by their GLBs. Two Quaternius archives were audited but are held from the project library because the package CC0 declarations conflict with the current QAL standalone-redistribution restriction. No download occurs during game launch.

assets.name: Kenney Car Kit - Sedan
assets.discovery_catalog_note: Discovery catalog only; the original publisher page and bundled archive license below were independently checked.
assets.author: Kenney
assets.redistribution_restrictions: No CC0 restriction identified in the bundled publisher license; retain this provenance record.
assets.optimization_status: 2.0k?2.8k triangles; shared 512?512 atlas. No authored wheel clips; runtime movement/lights remain procedural.
assets.runtime_integration: LIVE: scripts/three_d/vehicle_3d.gd renders this model and animates its imported wheel meshes; simulation code owns motion, collisions and emergency lights.
assets.notes: Static low-poly GLB; one shared 512?512 color atlas. No authored animation; wheel motion must come from the simulation renderer.
assets.godot_import_status: Godot 4.7.2 import completed; GLB/atlas loads passed the asset library check.
assets.preview_review_status: Godot 4.7.2 screenshot reviewed in isometric asset browser; test image is stored outside the project.
assets.conversion: Copied selected GLB geometry; rewrote only its external atlas URI to use the shared project texture. No mesh/material/animation data changes.

held_assets.name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library - Standard (in-place)
held_assets.discovery_catalog_note: Discovery catalog only; the original publisher page and bundled archive license below were independently checked.
held_assets.author: Quaternius (Gonzalo Furnier credited for animation assistance)
held_assets.redistribution_restrictions: No CC0 restriction identified in the bundled publisher license; retain this provenance record.
held_assets.optimization_status: 13.7k triangles and 43 clips; suitable for one preview instance, not yet budgeted for a full crowd.
held_assets.runtime_integration: PREVIEW_ONLY; production simulation renderer remains unchanged.
held_assets.notes: 43 clips in inspected GLB; 65-bone rig matches the Universal Base Characters rig. No root motion, so simulation-owned navigation remains authoritative. Preview only: ESSAIM live procedural avatars use a different rig.
held_assets.preview_review_status: Initial Godot 4.7.2 preview and clip/rig checks passed; local GLB was then removed pending license clarification.
held_assets.conversion: Copied publisher GLB byte-for-byte; chose in-place UAL1_Standard.glb (not the _RM root-motion variant).
held_assets.archive_license_statement: CC0-1.0 in the exact downloaded Standard archive and on the itch.io package page.
held_assets.current_official_terms: Quaternius Asset License (QAL) v1.0, updated 2026-08-28, allows commercial products but restricts redistribution of raw assets.
held_assets.license_scope_note: The package archive and current package page say CC0; the separate current QAL page says raw asset redistribution is restricted. Scope is unresolved for keeping the GLB in ESSAIM source. Per project policy, do not bundle until the publisher clarifies.
held_assets.audit_note: The file was temporarily imported to inspect the Godot rig/clip count, then removed from assets after the conflicting official terms were found. The original publisher archive remains in ignored .tools/asset-discovery/downloads/ and is not part of the project.
